title: Turn received peace into praise
summary: This meets the moment after relief, when the heart is tempted to drift back into old noise. The line says lasting peace stays living by Bani and Naam, not by memory alone.
takeaway: Answer relief with Bani before replay returns.
lifeApplication: After the argument ends, at the sink, in the car, or outside the doorway, speak one line of Bani aloud. Let praise settle the body before complaint takes the room back.

source.shortMeaning: Received peace stays alive through Bani, praise, and steady Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When relief arrives, speak Bani before the old replay starts again.
